description: Read current public status, URL and server-enforced expiry of an existing preview. Only the service owner can manually extend expiry; updates never extend it.

preview_id.description: Existing preview_id returned by AIfra. Do not invent it or pass a URL, alias, management key or source IP.

name: get_preview_status

active_slots_for_ip.description: Aggregate active-slot count, never the source IP.

expires_at.description: Server-enforced expiry, normally 48 hours from publication. Updates never extend it; only the owner can manually set a later date.

preview_id.description: AIfra preview identifier; never a management key.

ttl_seconds.description: Remaining seconds at response time, not a new lifetime.

url.description: Public viewer URL; share only after successful browser confirmation.
